description: Generate nested inward-offset contour rings at a fixed interval.
instructions:
Generates nested inward-offset rings (topographic-style contours) at a fixed `interval` (m), up to `maxLevels` rings — each ring is an output polygon carried on the single output handle.

TIP: use it for setback studies (each ring = a further setback), terracing / step-backs, or a quick read of how deep a Space is. A small `interval` with high `maxLevels` gives many fine rings; inner rings stop automatically once the offset collapses the shape. Wire a Space into the input handle.
